unit: task × frozen candidate version × native repeat

semantic_sampling.selection: uniform without replacement; retain inclusion probability; diagnostic cases excluded from weighted prevalence

confidence_interpretation: Analyst judgment, not a causal probability
phase_interpretation: Only actual runner executions or visible tool requests; absence of observation is unknown, not success or zero conditional failure. A phase may occur repeatedly or out of order.
prospective_rule: Analyst gets only current parent TRAIN traces and proposal/patch available before candidate execution. Freeze predictions before candidate evaluation. Independent test never enters optimizer or prospective packets.
comparisons: Astra/Luna/original DSH are read-only historical descriptions, with missing or incomparable records explicitly skipped. Only five benchmarks x dsh-summary/dsh-mechanism are active40-round arms. Both conditions share native start/model/task schedule/scorer/adoption, but later parent versions and trajectories can differ.
interventions: Existing intervention results retained as prior-scope background only. Current scope does not schedule new rollback, extra optimization arms or seeds.

feedback_output_budget.usage: Real CLI tokens and elapsed time recorded separately; completed earlier outputs retained with their original declared budgets.

checkpoint_policy: New ten feedback arms only may receive independent fixed-task observation replay; history never supplemented. Probes are training observations, never candidate selection or final independent tests.
